grid_run_commit_evidence: Owner supplied the run commit; the original report did not record it.
j34_eight_week_clock_starts: Date the commit containing this report is pushed to the public remote.
j34_selection_rule: Keep 12/6/3 unless a candidate beats pooled development overall MAE by more than one paired-gameweek standard error without worsening active-cohort MAE. Among candidates that clear this rule, choose the lowest pooled overall MAE.

post_run_reporting.selection_reason_derivation: Derived from each saved comparison's pooled improvement, paired standard error, pooled active-cohort MAE and default active-cohort MAE; checked against the saved qualifies value.
post_run_reporting.baseline_comparison_derivation: The pooled and per-fold baseline metric fields were already in the original report; the later code only added their printed comparison. No baseline metrics were recomputed.
